fusions.name: Curled Drop
fusions.desc: You curl into a ball and leap up to 6 tiles to the target, dealing 16 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Landing Quake
fusions.desc: Springs high and lands flat, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Spring Guard
fusions.desc: You spring 3 tiles forward and your armour rises by 20% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rebound Hide
fusions.desc: Your other abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter, and your armour is 8% higher.
